quick.title: The validate-xml script seems to only work with full tasks, not quick tasks
quick.problem: validate-xml.cjs fails when run with quick task path
quick.approach: Modify getXmlFilesForTask to detect quick/{id} paths and look in .kanban/quick/{id}/quick.xml instead of .kanban/tasks

constraints.constraint: Minimal change - only add quick task support
Don't refactor existing full task functionality

commit.message: quick(001): The validate-xml script seems to only work with full tasks, not quick tasks

quick.summary: Added support for quick tasks in validate-xml.cjs by detecting quick/{id} path prefix and looking in .kanban/quick/{id}/quick.xml
